SendFriendRequest.party_a: Key-only party in the sorted friendship PDA; handler requires a party to sign as requester.
SendFriendRequest.party_b: Key-only party in the sorted friendship PDA; handler requires a party to sign as requester.
AcceptFriendRequest.party_a: Key-only seed of the existing friendship PDA; handler authenticates its stored addressee signer.
AcceptFriendRequest.party_b: Key-only seed of the existing friendship PDA; handler authenticates its stored addressee signer.
CloseFriendship.party_a: Key-only seed of the friendship PDA; handler authenticates a stored party before rent closure.
CloseFriendship.party_b: Key-only seed of the friendship PDA; handler authenticates a stored party before rent closure.
BlockUser.party_a: Key-only seed of the friendship PDA; handler authenticates the signer against stored parties.
BlockUser.party_b: Key-only seed of the friendship PDA; handler authenticates the signer against stored parties.
LinkExternalElo.player: Key-only profile seed; typed profile authority is checked against this key and the linking authority signs.
VerifyProfile.player: Key-only seed for the typed canonical profile; the pinned KYC authority must sign.
SetUsername.authority: Key is constrained by the typed profile has_one; the player also signs and determines the profile PDA.
WithdrawExpiredWager.escrow_pda: Canonical escrow PDA; retained as the native SOL account or optional token-CPI signing authority.
DelegateGameCtx.game: Canonical Game PDA; v2 validates ownership and state before the SDK changes ownership during delegation.
DelegateGameCtx.owner_program: Address is pinned to this program; SDK uses its key as the delegated account owner.
DelegateGameCtx.buffer: SDK derives and creates the canonical delegation buffer with program PDA signer seeds.
DelegateGameCtx.delegation_record: Delegation Program CPI validates its record; this handler neither deserializes nor directly writes it.
DelegateGameCtx.delegation_metadata: Delegation Program CPI validates metadata; no direct application write or deserialization.
DelegateGameCtx.delegation_program: Address pinned to the SDK Delegation Program; runtime verifies the invoked program.
UndelegateGameCtx.game: Game PDA can have delegation ownership; handler deserializes its state and authenticates the payer before commit.
UndelegateGameCtx.magic_context: Address pinned to the SDK Magic context; forwarded to the Magic intent CPI.
UndelegateGameCtx.magic_program: Address pinned to the SDK Magic Program; used as the commit CPI target.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.game: Game PDA may be delegation-owned; handler deserializes it and enforces the stuck-game time guard.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.game: Canonical Game PDA may be delegation-owned; Delegation Program CPI enforces the rollback timeout.
GlobalCreateGame.player: Key is bound to the typed session player; its registered session key must sign.
GlobalCreateGame.game: Canonical fresh Game PDA is allocated, assigned, funded and serialized manually from the session vault.
GlobalCreateGame.escrow_pda: Canonical escrow PDA receives native SOL directly from the program-owned session vault.
GlobalJoinGame.player: Key is bound to the typed session player; its registered session key must sign.
GlobalJoinGame.escrow_pda: Canonical escrow PDA receives the wager from the authenticated program-owned session vault.
CreateGame.escrow_pda: Canonical escrow PDA receives the player-signed native SOL transfer; no account data is read.
JoinGame.escrow_pda: Canonical escrow PDA receives the joining player-signed native SOL transfer; no account data is read.
CancelTournament.usdc_prize_escrow_autho: Canonical per-tournament PDA used only as the token escrow ATA authority and CPI signer.
InitializeTournament.usdc_prize_escrow_a: Canonical per-tournament PDA used only as the optional token escrow ATA authority.
ClaimTournamentPrize.usdc_prize_escrow_a: Canonical per-tournament PDA signs the checked token transfer from its constrained escrow ATA.
FundUsdcPrize.usdc_prize_escrow_authorit: Canonical per-tournament PDA binds the recipient token escrow ATA; no account data is read.
ClaimTournamentPrize.claimant_wallet: Key equals the claimant signer and owner is constrained to System before native SOL payment.
StartTournament.host_treasury: Address equals the stored host treasury and owner is constrained to System before entry-fee payment.
RegisterPlayer.host_treasury: Address equals the stored tournament host treasury; retained for the deployed account interface.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.owner_program: Address pinned to this program; included in the exact SDK rollback instruction account list.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.delegation_pro: Address pinned to the SDK Delegation Program, which validates the rollback protocol.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.undelegation_r: Key checked against the SDK-generated instruction before CPI; Delegation Program validates protocol state.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.delegation_rec: Key checked against the SDK-generated instruction before CPI; Delegation Program validates protocol state.
RequestForceUndelegateCtx.delegation_met: Key checked against the SDK-generated instruction before CPI; Delegation Program validates protocol state.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.owner_pro: Address pinned to this program; included in the exact SDK rollback instruction account list.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.delegatio: Address pinned to the SDK Delegation Program, which validates the rollback protocol.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.undelegat: Key checked against the SDK-generated instruction before CPI; Delegation Program validates protocol state.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.delegatio: Key checked against the SDK-generated instruction before CPI; Delegation Program validates protocol state.

ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.commit_st: Key checked against the SDK rollback instruction; Delegation Program validates committed state.
ForceUndelegateAfterTimeoutCtx.commit_re: Key checked against the SDK rollback instruction; Delegation Program validates committed state.
SessionCreateGame.player: Key bound to a canonical enabled wallet authorization and a canonical registered-player shard; session key must sign.
SessionCreateGame.escrow_pda: Canonical per-game escrow; handler debits only the authenticated program-owned player vault.
SessionJoinGame.player: Key bound to a canonical enabled wallet authorization and a canonical registered-player shard; session key must sign.
SessionJoinGame.escrow_pda: Canonical per-game escrow; handler debits only the authenticated program-owned player vault.
SessionCreateGame.game: Canonical game PDA; handler checks empty System ownership, allocates and assigns before serializing.
CancelTimeCheck.magic_program: Fixed Magic Program ID; CPI target only, without application deserialization. The runtime resolves the invoked executable.
ScheduleTimeCheck.magic_program: Fixed Magic Program ID; CPI target only, without application deserialization. The runtime resolves the invoked executable.
CrankTimeCheck.white: Key-only scheduled account; Anchor requires the seat recorded on the canonical typed Game. No signer, ownership or serialization assumption is made.
CrankTimeCheck.black: Key-only scheduled account; Anchor requires the seat recorded on the canonical typed Game. No signer, ownership or serialization assumption is made.
ScheduleTimeCheck.white: Key-only scheduled account; Anchor requires the seat recorded on the canonical typed Game. No signer, ownership or serialization assumption is made.
ScheduleTimeCheck.black: Key-only scheduled account; Anchor requires the seat recorded on the canonical typed Game. No signer, ownership or serialization assumption is made.
CancelGame.black_authority: Canonical Game black seat; intentionally permits the System Program placeholder before join. Joined refund destination must be writable in the handler; no account data is trusted.
CreateTournamentGame.white: Key only; authenticated tournament authority, Active status, distinct seats and membership in canonical typed player shards are checked before game/session initialization.
RecordSwissResult.white: Key only; authenticated tournament authority and canonical player shards. Handler finds the player standing, bounds round/board, rejects duplicate boards and enforces the bye/distinct-seat rule.
CreateTournamentGame.black: Key only; authenticated tournament authority, Active status, distinct seats and membership in canonical typed player shards are checked before game/session initialization.
RecordSwissResult.black: Key only; authenticated tournament authority and canonical player shards. Handler finds the player standing, bounds round/board, rejects duplicate boards and enforces the bye/distinct-seat rule.
BindTournamentPass.pass_config: Foreign pass-program layout cannot use a local Account type. Cross-program config PDA is constrained; load_config checks owner, exact length, discriminator/version, then mint/registrar/rating policy.
BindTournamentPass.registrar: Uninitialized signer PDA is used only as a key at binding. Its canonical address must equal the foreign config registrar; no data is read.
RegisterPlayer.pass_binding: Mandatory canonical address supports both an absent System-owned empty PDA and an existing typed binding. Manual loader verifies owner/discriminator/tournament ID before any pass burn.
IssuePassEligibility.player: Key only; canonical typed profile supplies verified rating. Permissionless payer cannot choose a different profile for that player; player signature is intentionally unnecessary for attestation.
RevokePassEligibility.player: Key only in canonical foreign eligibility seeds; authenticated tournament authority requests revocation and the fixed pass program checks its own record.
IssuePassEligibility.pass_mint: Key pinned to the canonical tournament binding, whose tournament ID is also verified. Foreign config PDA derives from this mint; no mint data is deserialized here.
IssuePassEligibility.pass_config: Canonical foreign config PDA for the bound mint; fixed executable pass program validates its owner, type and authority during CPI. Not a locally owned account.
IssuePassEligibility.registrar: Canonical, potentially uninitialized local PDA; signs only the fixed pass-program CPI using the constant registrar seed and derived bump. No balance/data interpretation.
IssuePassEligibility.pass_program: Anchor pins both the external pass program address and executability; sole CPI target. Foreign program semantics remain an integration dependency.
RevokePassEligibility.pass_mint: Key pinned to the canonical tournament binding, whose tournament ID is also verified. Foreign config PDA derives from this mint; no mint data is deserialized here.
RevokePassEligibility.pass_config: Canonical foreign config PDA for the bound mint; fixed executable pass program validates its owner, type and authority during CPI. Not a locally owned account.
RevokePassEligibility.registrar: Canonical, potentially uninitialized local PDA; signs only the fixed pass-program CPI using the constant registrar seed and derived bump. No balance/data interpretation.
RevokePassEligibility.pass_program: Anchor pins both the external pass program address and executability; sole CPI target. Foreign program semantics remain an integration dependency.
SetPassPaused.pass_mint: Key pinned to the canonical tournament binding, whose tournament ID is also verified. Foreign config PDA derives from this mint; no mint data is deserialized here.
SetPassPaused.pass_config: Canonical foreign config PDA for the bound mint; fixed executable pass program validates its owner, type and authority during CPI. Not a locally owned account.
SetPassPaused.registrar: Canonical, potentially uninitialized local PDA; signs only the fixed pass-program CPI using the constant registrar seed and derived bump. No balance/data interpretation.
SetPassPaused.pass_program: Anchor pins both the external pass program address and executability; sole CPI target. Foreign program semantics remain an integration dependency.
IssuePassEligibility.eligibility_record: Canonical foreign mint/player PDA, either freshly issued or refreshed by the fixed pass program. Local refresh checks owner and the zero revocation flag; callee validates its complete layout.
RevokePassEligibility.eligibility_record: Canonical foreign mint/player record; the fixed pass program validates the complete record and registrar authority. The local tournament authority must sign.
